title: user.merged
description: A guest account was folded into an existing one on sign-in (stapel-auth 0.30.0): from_user_id ceased to exist and its rows belong to into_user_id. The other half of the account life cycle user.deleted answers, and the opposite instruction — moderation history is re-parented, not erased: Case.subject_user_id/claimed_by, Report.reporter_id, Verdict.actor_id, CaseEvent.actor_id, Sanction.subject_user_id/issued_by/lifted_by, Appeal.appellant_id/resolved_by. A sanction follows the person, or a merge would be a one-click ban-evasion route; carried sanctions are re-announced with moderation.sanction.issued so the user_sanctions read-model recomputes. Idempotent.
